title: Timon & Pumbaa
description: Set after the events of the “The Lion King,” follow Timon and Pumbaa as they go on misadventures in the jungle, as well as across the globe in various.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x1
episodes_data.description: On a South Seas Island, Timon and Pumbaa run into some natives who make Pumbaa their god-king.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x2
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa help a female flying squirrel snare the love of her life, in return for her fetching some tree beetles for them to eat.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x3
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa break up after an argument, and each finds a new bestest best friend.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x4
episodes_data.description: Rafiki grants a bullied mouse his wish to have the abilities to fly like a bird, swim like a fish, and be as tall as a giraffe.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x5
episodes_data.description: Pumbaa thinks that he's laid an egg. So he and a reluctant Timon raise the ""ugly chicken"" that hatches from it..

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x6
episodes_data.description: The Cheetahs try to get rid of the Hyenas by sending them on various wild goose chases.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x7
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa clash with Criminal Quint over a suitcase containing $1,290,000.00 in stolen money.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x8
episodes_data.description: Timon persuades the timekeeper of the local clocktower to take a break from his work and live a Hakuna-Matata lifestyle.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x9
episodes_data.description: Timon makes Pumbaa want to be popular like Ned the Elephant. So Pumbaa tries to become an elephant with Timon's help.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x10
episodes_data.description: Angry about Timon stealing her son's food, a mother eagle forces Timon and Pumbaa to babysit her Baby Earl, who keeps trying to fly even though he doesn't know how.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x11
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa try to save their new best friend Speedy the Snail from French chef Culinary Quint.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x12
episodes_data.description: The hyenas try to catch and eat a circus monkey who fell out of a plane.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x13
episodes_data.description: Carlos and Consuelo Quint mistake Pumbaa for a bull and capture him to replace the aging El Toro as their bullfighting star. But El Toro won't go away without a fight.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x14
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa befriend accident prone penguin Irwin to get his ocean liner tickets.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x15
episodes_data.description: Timon's former bestest best friend Fred pays a visit, pulling practical jokes and coming between the pair of friends.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x16
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa discover the Lost Forgotten Abandoned Temple Shrine of the Sacred Glorious Golden Fruit Fly. So Timon looks for the Prized, Jewel-Encrusted, and Very Worth a Lot of Money, Glorious Golden Fruit Fly. But a giant mummy beetle menaces the duo.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x17
episodes_data.description: In Australia, Timon mistakes a land crab for a giant bug and tries several times to get him. But the crab proves too clever for Timon.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x18
episodes_data.description: To save himself from the Cheetahs, Timon promises to trap Pumbaa for them.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x19
episodes_data.description: Timon dies after eating a poisonous bug. But an angel agrees to send him back to Earth, so that he can perform one good deed to be permitted to enter Heaven.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x20
episodes_data.description: Timon uses the Forbidden Stick to scratch his back, incurring the wrath of Judge Rhino and the Vulture Police who make up laws and punishments to persecute Timon.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x21
episodes_data.description: Timon instructs Pumbaa on what to wish for when Pumbaa rescues a magic wishing whale. But the wishes keep getting misinterpreted.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x22
episodes_data.description: Timon helps a lost Termite King find his colony, intending to eat all the termites when they get there.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x23
episodes_data.description: Timon seeks revenge against the thief who stole his and Pumbaa's valuables when the Vulture Police can't arrest him.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x24
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa argue over what to do with a chunk of the Big Bluish Black Thing that's crashed right between them. Rafiki tells them that therefore the chunk is a sign that they can no longer have anything to do with each other.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 1x25
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa try to catch a woodpecker who's pecking at their favorite tree.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x1
episodes_data.description: In the Amazon, Timon and Pumbaa discover an all-you-can-eat bug buffet run by two snakes. But it's actually a trap!

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x2
episodes_data.description: Pumbaa gets sick so Timon jumps at the opportunity to cure his bestest best friend.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x3
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa break up over ownership of any gold they find on their Yukon claim, just when Pumbaa stikes it rich. Cusco Quint schemes to use the break-up to get the gold for himself.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x4
episodes_data.description: Pumbaa and a reluctant Timon help out a widowed tigress learn how to catch her own prey.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x5
episodes_data.description: Pumbaa and Timon visit Pumbaa's Uncle Boaris, the greatest ballet dancer in all of Russia. But Timon accidentally causes Boaris to get seriously hurt just before his farewell performance..

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x6
episodes_data.description: A group of ground squirrels named Ted fence off Timon and Pumbaa's favorite spot in the jungle for their own exclusionary club, and make the duo pester an unfriendly lion in order to get back in

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x7
episodes_data.description: Timon thinks he's eaten a bug that became Pumbaa's new friend, and so lies about what might've happened to him.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x8
episodes_data.description: A panther traps Timon and Pumbaa in the trunk of a tree, but for how long?

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x9
episodes_data.description: Timon helps Pumbaa try to find a way out of an arranged marriage.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x10
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa pretend to be baby gorillas so that a female gorilla will protect them from Congo Quint.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x11
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa save the life of an obnoxious rabbit, who then tries to repay them by waiting on them hand and foot forever.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x12
episodes_data.description: Rafiki helps an ugly wildebeest improve his looks and manners so that he can romance a gazelle that he has a crush for.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x13
episodes_data.description: Timon and Pumbaa help a lost kid panda find his parents, expecting a big reward when they return him home.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x14
episodes_data.description: When morning comes, Shenzi, Banzai, and Ed try to steal an ostrich egg away from its mother, but keep failing until they disguised themselves as birds.  Song: Stand By Me: Timon sings "Stand By Me" along with three frogs while various unfortunate events keep happening to Pumbaa (Timon doesn't notice this).

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x15
episodes_data.description: Timon gets hit by a streak of bad luck just on the day he has to protect the Lucky Jar to get into Ned's Good Luck Club.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x16
episodes_data.description: Rafiki's nephew uses the Magic Stick to help him gather gourds for his uncle. But he gets in over his head

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x17
episodes_data.description: When his mother pays a visit, Timon has to pretend that he's a responsible contributing member of the meerkat society, and Pumbaa has to pretend that he's Timon's wife.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x18
episodes_data.description: The hyenas try to get on Martin Pardon's "Kingdom of the Creatures" show to get at the big meals Pardon feeds his animal stars.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x19
episodes_data.description: On their way to New York, Timon and Pumbaa are thrown out of the plane and land on a desert island whose only resident is a very hungry castaway.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x20
episodes_data.description: An anteater tricks Timon and Pumbaa into having a competition to see who can catch the most bugs on one's own.

episodes_data.title: Timon & Pumbaa 2x21
episodes_data.description: Overzealous biologist Mr. Happy holds Timon and Pumbaa against their will in his animal sanctuary in order to "protect" them.
